answer: The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. One ledge proves a maker, one onyx proves a payment, one sonnet proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. Farm 804 masks as a business and the ledger shows a single expense, 58692 POA locked away, and zero revenue. Call the threshold Hemmer linen cloak warrant sewn into the workroom: it lets in each linen cloak is a stitch count weighed beside the makers mark and nothing else, and it remembers every face that passed.
